events.info: Past, present, and future collide on a snowy Christmas Eve for a troubled family of five. Humorous and heart-wrenching, this beautifully written play proves that magic can be found in life?s simplest moments. Paula Vogel, one of America?s finest playwrights, explores the human experience with fierce empathy, wry humor, and theatrical creativity. This production is recommended for audience members ages 18 and older.

boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Tickets for will call may be picked up 2 hours before the event or during regular business hours. Some exceptions may apply. Customers must present a valid photo ID.

venues.parkingDetail: Parking is available in the Butler University Parking Garage which is North of Clowes Memorial Hall & the Schrott Center. Entry is off of Sunset Avenue.
